Can Your Tongue Move a Healing Dental Implant?

Many patients who have recently received dental implants become concerned about potential damage from normal oral activities, particularly the movement of their tongue. This worry is completely understandable, as [dental implants](https://www.dental-implants-london.co.uk/) represent a significant investment in both time and money, and patients naturally want to ensure successful healing.

Does Mouth Breathing Harm Your Dental Implant?

Many patients worry about how everyday habits might affect their dental implants after treatment. One concern that frequently arises is whether mouth breathing could impact the success or longevity of dental implant restorations. This question often stems from patients who have seasonal allergies, sleep disorders, or nasal congestion issues that cause them to breathe predominantly through their mouth.

Does Sleeping Open-Mouthed Cause Implant Infection?
